modules.note: Provides Device Integrity without modifying GMS memory directly.

modules.name: SUSFS Kernel Module / Daemon
modules.note: Required to hide unlocked bootloader (/proc/bootconfig) and su mount traces from DroidGuard native checks.

modules.name: Zygisk NoHello
modules.note: Hides Zygisk presence and socket IPC from detection tools.

modules.name: Play Integrity Fix (PIF)
modules.note: MANDATORY: Must be disabled on Android 16 / HyperOS 3. Injects arm64-v8a.so into GMS unstable which triggers direct crash and causes Basic Integrity to FAIL.

modules.name: Treat Wheel
modules.note: Conficts with modern Zygisk hooks on Android 16.

technical_notes: BASIC=FAIL occurs when PIF or conflicting Zygisk modules inject libraries into com.google.android.gms.unstable.
DroidGuard on Android 16 directly opens /proc/bootconfig to read 'androidboot.verifiedbootstate=orange'. Built-in SUSFS is required to intercept and hide this.
STRONG Integrity check uses hardware-backed attestation verified against Google Cloud CRL. Public keybox certificates are revoked. A private unrevoked keybox is mandatory for Strong.
